en.NAME: Blog · API Base
en.DESCRIPTION: Core CMS base path used for the public blog-post endpoint.

en.NAME: Blog · Organization
en.DESCRIPTION: Organization code used in the public Core CMS request.

en.NAME: Blog · Visible Page Size
en.DESCRIPTION: Number of cards revealed per page after the featured article.

en.NAME: Blog · Maximum Results
en.DESCRIPTION: Safety limit for articles loaded from Core CMS.

en.NAME: Blog · Index Path
en.DESCRIPTION: Public localized route used by the blog index.

en.NAME: Blog · Post Path
en.DESCRIPTION: Public localized route prefix used when building article links.

en.NAME: Blog · Fixture URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Local preview-only JSON URL. Use # in CMS to disable fixture loading.

en.NAME: Blog Index · Read Article Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible card action label.

en.NAME: Blog Index · Empty Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Status shown when the backend returns no posts.

en.NAME: Blog Index · Error Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Status shown when the backend request fails.

en.NAME: Blog Index · Filter All Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Category filter chip that shows every article.

en.NAME: Blog Index · Eyebrow
en.DESCRIPTION: Short label above the page heading.

en.NAME: Blog Index · H1
en.DESCRIPTION: Primary blog index heading.

en.NAME: Blog Index · Filters Aria Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label for the category filter group.

en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label for the article card grid.

en.DESCRIPTION: Pagination button label.

en.NAME: Meta Title
en.DESCRIPTION: Server-rendered social title. Core CMS replaces it with the BlogPost metadata key META_TITLE while an article is rendered.

en.NAME: Meta Description
en.DESCRIPTION: Server-rendered social description. Core CMS replaces it with the BlogPost metadata key META_DESCRIPTION while an article is rendered.

en.NAME: Hero Image URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Server-rendered social image. Core CMS replaces it with the BlogPost metadata key HERO_IMAGE_URL while an article is rendered.

en.NAME: Blog · API Base
en.DESCRIPTION: Core CMS base path used for the public blog-post endpoint.

en.NAME: Blog · Organization
en.DESCRIPTION: Organization code used in the public Core CMS request.

en.NAME: Blog · Category ID
en.DESCRIPTION: Backend category ID used for related posts. Use 0 to include every category.

en.NAME: Blog · API Page Size
en.DESCRIPTION: Number of backend posts requested per page.

en.NAME: Blog · Maximum Results
en.DESCRIPTION: Safety limit for posts loaded from Core CMS.

en.NAME: Blog · Index Path
en.DESCRIPTION: Public localized route used by the blog index and breadcrumb link.

en.NAME: Blog · Post Path
en.DESCRIPTION: Public localized route prefix used to resolve the current permalink and build related article links.

en.NAME: Blog · Fixture URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Local preview-only JSON URL. Use # in CMS to disable fixture loading.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Read Article Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Related card action label.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Related Limit
en.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of related article cards.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Copy Link Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label of the copy-link share button.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Link Copied Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Confirmation announced after the article link is copied.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Breadcrumb Aria Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label for article navigation.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Blog Link Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Link label returning to the blog index.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Article Fallback Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Temporary breadcrumb label before article metadata resolves.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Share Aria Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label for the share button group.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Tags Aria Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label for the article tag list.

en.NAME: Author Avatar
en.DESCRIPTION: Server-rendered author avatar URL. Core CMS replaces it with the BlogPost metadata key AUTHOR_AVATAR while an article is rendered.

en.NAME: Author Name
en.DESCRIPTION: Server-rendered author name. Core CMS replaces it with the BlogPost metadata key AUTHOR_NAME while an article is rendered.

en.NAME: Author Bio
en.DESCRIPTION: Server-rendered author biography. Core CMS replaces it with the BlogPost metadata key AUTHOR_BIO while an article is rendered.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Related Eyebrow
en.DESCRIPTION: Label above related articles.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Related H2
en.DESCRIPTION: Related articles heading.

en.NAME: Blog Post · Related Aria Label
en.DESCRIPTION: Accessible label for related article cards.

en.NAME: SEO LD Schema
en.DESCRIPTION: Server-rendered schema.org JSON-LD. Core CMS replaces it with the BlogPost metadata key SEO_LD_SCHEMA while an article is rendered.
